verdict.rationale: a-Shell includes vim for editing and explicitly documents running syntax checkers via vim-lsp or ALE, plus compilers (clang) for C/C++ that surface errors, giving direct dev feedback loops. However, evidence is limited to a single doc mention of lint plugins with no hands-on confirmation of vim-lsp/ALE actually working in the constrained iOS environment, and no dedicated linter tools (e.g., pylint, eslint) are documented as installable. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that vim-lsp/ALE function correctly on iOS, and evidence of standard linters being installable via pkg/pip.
